description: `case t when "pypi" ... else ... end` -- the dispatch `purl.rb#normalize` and `identify.rb#registry_package` are both written as. `case/when` desugars to a temp plus a chain of `===` sends against that temp, which is clink 12's finding (narrowing cannot be a syntactic rewrite) arriving from the target rather than from a hand-written rung -- and with `String#===` rather than `Module#===`, so it needs no refinement at all, only a join.
